doctrine: EPHEMERAL TOOL GENESIS — Agentic Capability Without Authority Creep
iron_rule: Agent boleh mencipta CAPABILITY. Agent TIDAK BOLEH mencipta AUTHORITY.

1_sense_read.desc: Read web, files, databases, APIs, sensors, time, system state

2_compute.desc: Calculate, run Python/shell, process data, simulate options

3_memory.desc: Remember, retrieve, correct, forget — with provenance

4_resolve_route.desc: Determine which organ or tool the mission needs

5_communicate.desc: Interact with humans, agents, external systems

6_act_forge.desc: Write files, call APIs, build code, change systems

7_verify_govern.desc: Test results, control permissions, rollback, audit, stop harm

ephemeral_genesis_loop.description: Agent tidak perlu 128 permanent tools. Ia perlu kemampuan membina alat SEMENTARA apabila misi memerlukannya.

inspect_gap.desc: Detect what capability is missing. Search existing tools first.
inspect_gap.output: Gap report: what's needed, why existing tools can't serve, minimum viable capability spec

generate_ephemeral.desc: Generate temporary tool code in sandbox. Parser, calculator, transformer, scraper, adapter.
generate_ephemeral.output: Ephemeral tool artifact (script, function, or adapter) with sandbox policy
generate_ephemeral.constraints: READONLY_BUILD sandbox. No secrets. No network unless NETWORKED_READ preset. Must be <500 lines. Single purpose.

sandbox_test.desc: Test the ephemeral tool against sample input. Verify output correctness.
sandbox_test.output: Test report: pass/fail, edge cases, resource usage
sandbox_test.constraints: READONLY_BUILD sandbox. Must pass before invocation.

invoke_ephemeral.desc: Execute the ephemeral tool against real mission data. Minimum necessary permission.
invoke_ephemeral.input: Tested ephemeral tool + mission data + permission scope
invoke_ephemeral.constraints: Minimum sandbox preset needed. Never FULL_TRUSTED for ephemeral. Network only if NETWORKED_READ + allowed domains.

verify_output.desc: Independent verification that ephemeral tool output is correct and safe.
verify_output.constraints: Must use different method than tool itself. Cross-check when possible.

propose_promotion.desc: If tool was used ≥3 times successfully, propose promotion to permanent. HUMAN MUST APPROVE.
propose_promotion.input: Ephemeral tool + usage history + success rate
propose_promotion.constraints: NEVER auto-promote. Arif's approval is gate. No promotion without evidence of repeated value.

retire.desc: Destroy ephemeral tool. Clean sandbox. Remove all artifacts. Log retirement.
retire.constraints: ALWAYS retire after mission unless propose_promotion approved. Auto-retire after 24h.

authority_firewall.principle: Digital action mudah dibina. Akibat digital masih boleh irreversible. Authority firewall adalah mutlak.

presets.READONLY_BUILD: Read project files, write /tmp only, no network. Lint/test/typecheck.
presets.NETWORKED_READ: Read project, network for APIs, write /tmp only. API calls, web research.
presets.FULL_TRUSTED: Full access after SEAL verdict. Deploy, push, forge. NEVER for ephemeral tools.

sandbox_substrate.isolation: User namespace, network namespace, PID namespace, IPC namespace, UTS namespace

integration.arif_route: Searches existing tools first. Only routes to arif_forge if gap detected.
integration.arif_forge: Runs the 7-mode genesis loop. Sandboxed. Governed.
integration.arif_judge: Determines permission scope for each ephemeral invocation. Gates promotion proposals.
integration.arif_memory: Stores successful ephemeral recipes for reuse. Remembers what worked.
integration.arif_seal: Records only persistent changes. Ephemeral tools that are retired leave only a receipt.

success_metric.is: Missions completed using ephemeral tools that were created, used, verified, and retired without Arif ever seeing a tool name
